notes: Every song that plays from a source has a save button on its row and beside the player, so keeping it is one visible tap instead of a two second hold.
A song now starts from its first second instead of after its whole file has arrived, so a tap makes sound in a moment and the rest of the file is read behind it.
The whole copy takes over from the opening at the second you have reached, so the song plays through and the next tap on it is instant.
